paper: APPSC Panchayat Secretary (Grade-IV) Group-III Services Screening Test 2017 (Notification No.29/2016), Series A booklet ESP/333, General Studies questions, held 23-04-2017
source_paper: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1RZxjsArBPog-UZwAvdyUs6iLh57TzcaL/view (Eenadu Pratibha copy of the Series A booklet, linked from questionpapersonline.com; same paper as https://blogmedia.testbook.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/appsc-panchayat-secretary-screening-test-2016-f6815609.pdf)
source_key: https://testbook.com/appsc-panchayat-secretary/previous-year-papers (Testbook 'APPSC Panchayat Secretary 2016 Official Paper' solutions, one testbook.com/question-answer page per question)

questions.s: Chandranna Bima Scheme is an insurance scheme to cover death and disability in case of
questions.x: Chandranna Bima (launched 2 October 2016) is Andhra Pradesh's insurance scheme for unorganised workers. It covers accidental death, disability and natural death.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: As per Andhra Pradesh Budget 2017-18, what portion of the Government's expenditure is estimated to be spent on debt servicing, i.e., debt repayments and interest payments during FY 2017-18 ?
questions.x: Budget 2017-18 estimated debt servicing (interest plus repayments) at about Rs 22,800 crore. Against total spending of about Rs 1,57,000 crore, that is roughly 14.5%.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: What is the name of the online forum for redressal of public grievances of the Government of Andhra Pradesh?
questions.x: Meekosam (meekosam.ap.gov.in, 2015) was the Andhra Pradesh government's online portal for registering and redressing public grievances.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: As per the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2017-18, what is the position of Andhra Pradesh in India in the production of fruits ?
questions.x: The 2017-18 AP Budget said Andhra Pradesh ranked first in India in fruit production.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: What is the expected date of implementation of GST as informed by the Finance Minister of India ?
questions.x: The Finance Minister announced 1 July 2017 as the GST rollout date, and GST did start on 1 July 2017.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: After the enactment of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganization Act, what amount of Central Assistance is provided by the Central Government to the State of Andhra Pradesh till mid March, 2017 (rounded off to nearest crore of rupees) ?
questions.x: The Finance Ministry said in March 2017 that Rs 10,461 crore of central assistance had been released to AP under the Reorganisation Act: Rs 4,403 crore in 2014-15, Rs 2,000 crore in 2015-16 and Rs 4,058 crore in 2016-17. (Testbook answer not found; answer checked independently.)
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: Which of the following is not a function of NITI Aayog ?
o: Providing directional and policy inputs to the Centre
Finalization of financial resource allocation to the States
questions.x: NITI Aayog is an advisory think tank and does not allocate funds. Devolution to states follows Finance Commission recommendations, a role the old Planning Commission partly held.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: 'Panta Sanjeevani' programme of the Government of Andhra Pradesh is on the
questions.x: Panta Sanjeevani was AP's drive to dig farm ponds on farmers' fields for rainwater harvesting, under MGNREGS convergence.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: The 61st Amendment to the Constitution reduced the voting age from 21 to 18 years in case of elections to
o: Lok Sabha and Legislative Assemblies of States
questions.x: The 61st Amendment (1988, in force 1989) amended Article 326 to lower the voting age from 21 to 18 for Lok Sabha and State Assembly elections.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: From the following, identify the item on which only the Supreme Court has the original jurisdiction ?
questions.x: Under Article 131, only the Supreme Court can hear disputes between the Centre and states or between states. High Courts also protect fundamental rights and hear appeals and PILs.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: What is a Court of Record ?
o: A court where judicial records are kept for security reasons
A court whose decision becomes a precedent
A court to deal with litigation on records
questions.x: As a court of record (Articles 129 and 215), a court's judgments are kept permanently, carry evidentiary value and bind lower courts as precedents. It can also punish for contempt.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Out of the given answers, in which situation does the Writ of Mandamus not lie to compel the Government ?
o: Appoint a Commission to study climate changes
Fill vacant seats in a Government Medical College
Construct cyclone shelters in a cyclone prone area
questions.x: Mandamus enforces a clear public or legal duty. Setting up a commission to study climate change is a discretionary policy choice that no law requires, so mandamus will not lie.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Our Constitution grants National Language status to
questions.x: The Constitution names no national language. Article 343 makes Hindi in Devanagari the official language of the Union, and English continues under the Official Languages Act.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: If an Indian citizen settles in another country, can he obtain citizenship of that country while retaining the Indian citizenship ?
questions.x: India allows only single citizenship. Under Article 9 and Section 9 of the Citizenship Act, 1955, an Indian who voluntarily acquires another country's citizenship stops being an Indian citizen.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Under the Right to Education conferred by the Constitution under "The Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009", an unaided school has to admit what percentage of students from the weaker sections and disadvantaged groups in the neighbourhood in class I or pre-school, as applicable ?
questions.x: Section 12(1)(c) of the RTE Act, 2009 requires unaided private schools to admit at least 25% of their Class I (or pre-school) intake from weaker and disadvantaged children in the neighbourhood. (Testbook answer not found; answer checked independently.)
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: What is "Composite floor test" in case of voting in a State Assembly ?
o: Voting in the Assembly as directed by the Speaker to when there is more than one person staking claim to form Government and majority is not clear.
Voting in the Assembly as directed by the Governor when there is more than one person staking claim to form Government and majority is not clear.
Voting in the Assembly to approve different bills at one time.
Voting in the Assembly wherein Legislators from Government and Opposition sit in a mingled fashion and vote in pairs.
questions.x: When several leaders claim majority and the position is unclear, the Governor can order a composite floor test, in which the House chooses between the claimants in one vote.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Under Article 352 of the Constitution, the President can declare national emergency
o: On advice of the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court
On written advice from the Cabinet
On advice of the Home Minister of India
questions.x: Since the 44th Amendment (1978), the President can proclaim a national emergency under Article 352 only after the Union Cabinet's decision is communicated in writing.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: If the posts of President and Vice-President fall vacant at the same time, who will act as the President of India ?
questions.x: Under the President (Discharge of Functions) Act, 1969, the Chief Justice of India acts as President when both posts are vacant (as Justice Hidayatullah did in 1969).
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: In which of the Houses, can a money bill be introduced ?
o: Only in a joint sitting of the Houses
questions.x: Under Article 109, a money bill can be introduced only in the Lok Sabha, on the President's recommendation. The Rajya Sabha can only make recommendations within 14 days.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Generally, on what day would a private member's bill be discussed in the Lok Sabha ?
questions.x: The second half of Friday sittings in the Lok Sabha is usually set aside for private members' business, including private members' bills.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Which section of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganization Act, 2014 was amended by the Andhra Pradesh Reorganization Amendment Ordinance, 2014 which is popularly known as Polavaram Ordinance Bill ?
questions.x: The 2014 Polavaram Ordinance amended Section 3 of the AP Reorganisation Act (the territories of Telangana), moving seven mandals that the Polavaram project would submerge from Telangana to Andhra Pradesh.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: As per Section 26 of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganization Act, 2014, the Assembly constituencies in Andhra Pradesh can be increased through delimitation from the present number of 175 to
questions.x: Section 26 of the AP Reorganisation Act provides for raising Andhra Pradesh's Assembly seats from 175 to 225 (and Telangana's from 119 to 153), subject to Article 170. (Testbook answer not found; answer checked independently.)
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: As per the Andhra Pradesh Reorganization Act, 2014, which caste is deleted from the list pertaining to Andhra Pradesh in the Constitution (Scheduled Castes) Order, 1950 ?
questions.x: The Fifth Schedule to the Reorganisation Act amended the SC Order, 1950, deleting Beda (Budga) Jangam from the Andhra Pradesh list.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: As per the Andhra Pradesh Reorganization Act, 2014, the salaries and allowances of Judges of the Common High Court are
o: Apportioned between the States in 50 : 50 ratio
Apportioned between the States in population ratio
The amounts are paid by the Central Government
Apportioned between the States on the basis of cases filed in the Court
questions.x: The Act says the salaries and allowances of judges of the common High Court at Hyderabad are shared between AP and Telangana in the population ratio. (Testbook answer not found; answer checked independently.)
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: The High Court for the State of Andhra Pradesh has to be constituted under which Article of the Constitution ?
questions.x: Article 214 provides for a High Court for each state. The Reorganisation Act kept a common High Court until a separate one was set up for Andhra Pradesh under Article 214, which happened on 1 January 2019. (Testbook answer not found; answer checked independently.)
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: APSFC is listed in which Schedule of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganization Act, 2014 ?
questions.x: The AP State Financial Corporation is listed among the corporations in the Ninth Schedule of the Reorganisation Act, whose assets and liabilities are divided between the two states.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: As per Section 46 of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganization Act, 2014, the apportionment between both the States of the award of the 13th Finance Commission has to be done
o: In the population ratio and other parameters
As determined by Sheela Bhide Committee
As determined by the 14th Finance Commission
questions.x: Section 46 splits the 13th Finance Commission's award between the successor states in the population ratio and on other parameters.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Who are the members of the 3-member Committee recently constituted by the Government of Andhra Pradesh on the issue of division of assets between Andhra Pradesh and Telangana ?
o: Shri Y. Rama Krishnudu, Shri K. Atchannaidu and Shri Ganta Srinivasa Rao
Shri Y. Rama Krishnudu, Shri K. Atchannaidu and Shri K. Srinivasulu
Shri K.E. Krishna Murthy, Shri Ganta Srinivasa Rao and Shri K. Srinivasulu
Shri K.E. Krishna Murthy, Shri P. Narayana and Shri P. Keshav
questions.x: In 2017 Andhra Pradesh named a three-minister committee on the division of assets with Telangana: Finance Minister Y. Ramakrishnudu, K. Atchannaidu and Government Whip K. Srinivasulu.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Under Section 51(1) of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganization Act, 2014, the right to collect the deferred taxes from industrial units vests
o: On 50 : 50 basis to both the States
On population ratio between both the States
With the State in which the unit is located
For both the States on the basis of turnover of the industrial unit from different regions of the common State
questions.x: Under Section 51(1), the right to collect deferred taxes from an industrial unit belongs to the successor state where the unit is located.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: At the time bifurcation, the Debt/GSDP ratios of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana States, as evident from the White Paper published by the Government of Andhra Pradesh in August, 2014 were
questions.x: Testbook's key, based on the August 2014 AP White Paper, gives debt/GSDP ratios of 19.4% for Andhra Pradesh and 18.1% for Telangana.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: Which is the "Appointed Day" mentioned in the Andhra Pradesh Reorganization Act, 2014 ?
questions.x: The Act fixed 2 June 2014 as the 'appointed day' when Telangana and residuary Andhra Pradesh came into existence. The President gave assent on 1 March 2014.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Which of the following committees was appointed by the Central Government to study the Community Development Programmes ?
questions.x: The Balwant Rai Mehta Committee (1957) reviewed the Community Development Programme and the National Extension Service, and recommended three-tier Panchayati Raj.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Which of the following reports is commissioned by the Central Government to assess the policy and legislative framework and outcomes of the States in respect of Panchayati Raj ?
questions.x: The Ministry of Panchayati Raj commissions an annual Devolution Index report, prepared by an independent institution, that ranks states on devolving funds, functions and functionaries to panchayats. (Testbook answer not found; answer checked independently.)
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Panchayati Raj Institutions were established for the first time in India on
questions.x: Nehru inaugurated Panchayati Raj at Nagaur, Rajasthan on 2 October 1959. Andhra Pradesh followed on 1 November 1959.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: The Ashok Mehta Committee recommended
questions.x: The Ashok Mehta Committee (1977-78) recommended two tiers: a Zilla Parishad at district level and Mandal Panchayats below it.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Out of the persons mentioned below, who pioneered the Community Development Programmes in independent India ?
questions.x: S.K. Dey, India's first Minister of Community Development and Cooperation, pioneered the Community Development Programme from 1952.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Which of the following is not one of the provisions incorporated by the 73rd Amendment to the Constitution ?
o: Reservation in seats for the SCs and STs
Setting up of State Election Commissions
questions.x: The 73rd Amendment provides for three tiers, reservation for SCs, STs and women, and State Election Commissions. It provides nothing like caste panchayats.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: What was Mahatma Gandhi's view on the Village Panchayats ?
o: Provincial Government should fully control Panchayats.
Panchayats should be kept free from elections.
questions.x: Gandhi wanted each village to be a self-sufficient 'village republic' run by its panchayat (Gram Swaraj).
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: How many subjects are mentioned in the Eleventh Schedule of the Constitution ?
questions.x: The Eleventh Schedule, added by the 73rd Amendment, lists 29 subjects that can be devolved to panchayats.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: What is the name of the annual award given by the Central Government to States to incentivize the implementation of e-Panchayat initiatives ?
questions.x: The Ministry of Panchayati Raj gives the e-Panchayat Puraskar (listed here as 'e-Puraskar') to states and panchayats for using ICT in panchayats.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: What is the annual allocation under local bodies grants for Panchayati Raj Institutions by the Central Government to the State of Andhra Pradesh for the year 2016-17 ?
questions.x: Testbook gives Rs 1,463.45 crore as AP's 2016-17 allocation of 14th Finance Commission local body grants for panchayats.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: As per the Andhra Pradesh Panchayat Raj Act, 1994, a meeting of the Gram Sabha should be organised at least
questions.x: Under the AP Panchayat Raj Act, 1994, a Gram Sabha must meet at least twice a year.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: What was the name of the rural development scheme implemented by the Provincial Government headed by Shri T. Prakasam in 1946 ?
questions.x: Tanguturi Prakasam's Madras Provincial Government launched the Firka Development Scheme in 1946, a Gandhian rural development plan based on the firka (a group of villages).
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: Under the Madras Village Panchayats Act, 1950, panchayats were categorized into how many classes ?
questions.x: The Madras Village Panchayats Act, 1950 sorted panchayats into two classes (Class I and Class II) by population and income.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Which was the mode of election for members of the Panchayat Samithi, under the Andhra Pradesh Panchayat Samithis and Zilla Parishads Act of 1959 ?
o: All Village Panchayat Presidents under the Samithi were ex-officio members
Elected by ward members of Village Panchayats under the Samithi
One member was nominated by each Village Panchayat under the Samithi
questions.x: Under the AP Panchayat Samithis and Zilla Parishads Act, 1959, the sarpanches (presidents) of village panchayats in the block were ex officio members of the Panchayat Samithi. (Testbook answer not found; answer checked independently.)
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: In which year, were the Panchayat Samithis abolished and Mandal Praja Parishads established in Andhra Pradesh ?
questions.x: The AP Mandal Praja Parishads, Zilla Praja Parishads and Zilla Pranalika Abhivrudhi Mandals Act, 1986 abolished the Panchayat Samithis and created Mandal Praja Parishads.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: How many mandals were formed in Andhra Pradesh (United State before Reorganization in 2014) after abolition of the Panchayat Samithis ?
questions.x: About 1,104 mandals replaced the old panchayat samithis (blocks) in undivided Andhra Pradesh in 1986.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Which of the following is a recommendation of M.T. Raju Committee ?
o: Setting up of District Development Boards
Setting up of Block Development Boards
questions.x: The M.T. Raju Committee in Andhra Pradesh recommended setting up District Development Boards.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Which of the following is a recommendation of C. Narasimham Committee ?
o: Setting up of District Development Boards
Setting up of Mandal Praja Parishads
Reservation of seats for women in Zilla Parishad
Direct election of the Panchayat Sarpanch
questions.x: Testbook's key says the C. Narasimham Committee in Andhra Pradesh recommended reserving seats for women in Zilla Parishads.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: The objective of establishment of Mandal Praja Parishad was to
o: Minimize the gap between the common man and officials for better administration
Revert back to the old system of Blocks for better administration
Implement changes in the Panchayat Raj system as directed by the Centre
questions.x: Mandal Praja Parishads, smaller than the old blocks, were meant to bring administration closer to the people and narrow the gap between citizens and officials.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: What is the number of children mentioned in Section 19(3) of the Andhra Pradesh Panchayat Raj Act, 1994 with regard to disqualification for election as a member of panchayat ?
questions.x: Section 19(3) disqualifies a person with more than two children, so the number mentioned is 2. Testbook's page lists a different option 4 ('More than 2') and marks that option; on this booklet the matching choice is 2.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Approximately how many job cards were issued by the Government of Andhra Pradesh under MGNREGA Scheme during 2016-17 (choose the nearest figure) ?
questions.x: Testbook gives about 85 lakh MGNREGA job cards in Andhra Pradesh in 2016-17.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: What is the percentage of expenditure spent on wages for unskilled labour out of total expenditure under MGNREGA Scheme during 2016-17 in Andhra Pradesh ? (choose the nearest figure)
questions.x: Unskilled wages are about 70% of MGNREGA spending (national labour share 73.85% in 2016-17; the Act caps material at 40%). The nearest option is 70%, but the AP-specific figure is unverified. (Testbook answer not found.)
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: Which one of the following is not one of the objectives of the MGNREGA Act ?
o: Providing higher education for rural youth
Strengthening the livelihood resource base of the poor
questions.x: MGNREGA aims at wage employment, durable rural assets, stronger livelihoods, social inclusion and stronger PRIs. Higher education for rural youth is not one of its objectives.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: In which scheme are "Barefoot technicians" engaged ?
questions.x: Under MGNREGA, local youth are trained as 'Barefoot Technicians' to measure and supervise works.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: Where is the National Institute of Rural Development and Panchyati Raj located ?
questions.x: The National Institute of Rural Development and Panchayati Raj (NIRDPR) is at Rajendranagar, Hyderabad. (Testbook answer not found; answer checked independently.)
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: What is the size of a Gram Panchayat in plain areas in terms of population, for selection under Sansad Adarsh Gram Yojana ?
questions.x: Under Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana, a Gram Panchayat of 3,000-5,000 people in plain areas (1,000-3,000 in hilly and tribal areas) is chosen.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: Which one of the following works is not permissible under MGNREGA ?
questions.x: Testbook marks the mini percolation tank as the impermissible work. Water-harvesting structures are usually allowed under MGNREGA, so this key is doubtful.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: Select the major programme that aims to provide road connectivity in the villages.
questions.x: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (2000) provides all-weather road connectivity to unconnected rural habitations.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: Which part of the Constitution helps in identifying PESA districts in Andhra Pradesh ?
questions.x: PESA, 1996 applies to Fifth Schedule (Scheduled) Areas, so the Fifth Schedule identifies AP's PESA areas. (Testbook answer not found; answer checked independently.)
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: PRIA software is meant to
o: capture receipt and expenditure including voucher entries and generates cash book, reports and register
facilitate monitoring physical and financial outcomes
questions.x: PRIASoft (Panchayati Raj Institutions Accounting Software) records receipts and expenditure from voucher entries and generates cash books, registers and reports.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: House tax in a village in Andhra Pradesh is collected by the
questions.x: House tax is a compulsory tax that the Gram Panchayat levies and collects under the AP Panchayat Raj Act.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Funds for SAGY villages do not come from
o: Own revenue of the Gram Panchayat
Central and State Finance Commission Grants
questions.x: SAGY has no dedicated funds. Works are funded from existing schemes, MPLADS, the Gram Panchayat's own revenue, Finance Commission grants and CSR. There is no 'SAGY surcharge'.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: Decentralization of power through Local Self-Government is aimed at
o: Balancing of power amongst caste groups
questions.x: Decentralisation through local self-government brings people into decision-making, which promotes participative democracy.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Under the Sansad Adarsh Gram Yojana Scheme, in a year, a Member of Parliament can suggest to the District Collector, quantum of works worth
questions.x: MPs suggest works to the District Collector through MPLADS, which allowed Rs 5 crore a year per MP at that time. SAGY works can draw on MPLADS. (Testbook answer not found; answer checked independently.)
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: What is the literal meaning of the word "Panchayat" ?
o: Assembly of five respected persons chosen by community
questions.x: 'Panchayat' means an assembly (ayat) of five (panch) respected elders chosen by the community to settle disputes.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: In which of the below mentioned States/Union Territories, the Panchayati Raj system does not exist ?
questions.x: Delhi has no Panchayati Raj institutions. Andaman & Nicobar, Lakshadweep and Manipur's valley areas have panchayats. (Testbook answer not found; answer checked independently.)
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: In how many districts of Andhra Pradesh is the PESA Act implemented ?
questions.x: PESA areas in AP are in five districts with Scheduled Areas: Srikakulam, Vizianagaram, Visakhapatnam, East Godavari and West Godavari.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: What percentage of seats are reserved for women in Panchayati Raj institutions ?
questions.x: Article 243D reserves at least one-third (about 33%) of seats for women in PRIs. Andhra Pradesh itself later raised this to 50%.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: The recommendations of the State Finance Commission are
o: Not binding on the State Government
Binding on the State Government with regard to formula of devolution
Binding on the State Government on Panchayat Raj Schemes
questions.x: State Finance Commissions (Article 243I) make recommendations. They advise the Governor, and the state government is not bound by them.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Who is the Chairman of the Fourth Finance Commission constituted by the Government of Andhra Pradesh?
questions.x: Andhra Pradesh's Fourth State Finance Commission, notified in 2015, was chaired by Prof. M.L. Kantha Rao.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: Which are the districts that have Agricultural Export Zones in Andhra Pradesh ?
questions.x: Andhra Pradesh's Agri Export Zones are Chittoor (mango pulp and vegetables), Krishna (mangoes) and Guntur (chillies).
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: What is the name of the Pledge Finance Scheme available to farmers of Andhra Pradesh to store their products and get finance ?
questions.x: Under Rythu Bandhu Pathakam, Agricultural Market Committees lend farmers up to 75% of the value of produce pledged in their godowns, interest-free at first.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: In the system of pulp wood trading introduced from February, 2016 by the Government of Andhra Pradesh, which of the following trees are not traded ?
questions.x: The 2016 pulpwood trading system covered Subabul, Eucalyptus and Casuarina. Bamboo was not covered.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: What is the approximate contribution of primary sector to GSDP of Andhra Pradesh in 2015-16 ?
questions.x: Testbook gives 25% for the primary sector's share of AP GSDP in 2015-16. Other estimates range from 27% to 30%, so treat this as approximate.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: What is the name of the community based microfinance organization floated by Mandal Samakhyas along with the Government of Andhra Pradesh ?
questions.x: Stree Nidhi Credit Cooperative Federation, set up by the AP government and the Mandal Mahila Samakhyas, gives SHG women quick microfinance.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: What is 'Anna Sanjivani' ?
o: Medical shops for generic medicines managed through Self-help groups
A cropping model using organic manure and pesticides
Mid-day Meal Scheme for school children
questions.x: Anna Sanjivani shops sell cheap generic medicines and are run by women's self-help groups under SERP/DRDA. (Testbook answer not found; answer checked independently.)
questions.subject: Indian Society

questions.s: The centralized database for identifying and providing services to persons with disabilities is called as
questions.x: SADAREM (Software for Assessment of Disabled for Access, Rehabilitation and Empowerment) is AP's computerised system for certifying persons with disabilities and providing them services. (Testbook answer not found; answer checked independently.)
questions.subject: Indian Society

questions.s: Which one of the following is the objective of the Unnathi Scheme of Andhra Pradesh ?
o: To provide scholarships to rural youth for higher education
To provide scholarships to minority students for higher education
To enable the poorest of poor to earn a minimum amount of ₹ 2 lakh per annum
To enable the poorest of poor to earn a minimum amount of ₹ 3 lakh per annum
questions.x: Testbook marks 'scholarships to rural youth', but SERP's Unnathi is a livelihood programme for the poorest families that aims at an income of about Rs 1 lakh a year. The key is doubtful and no option fits exactly.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: What is the amount of contribution per annum to be met by a woman member of a Self-help group to avail the benefits of Abhaya Hastham Scheme ?
questions.x: Under Abhaya Hastham, an SHG woman pays Re 1 a day (Rs 365 a year) and the government adds a matching amount to her pension fund.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: How many new pensions were sanctioned by the Government of Andhra Pradesh in January, 2017 under NTR Bharosa Scheme?
questions.x: Andhra Pradesh sanctioned about 3.5 lakh new NTR Bharosa pensions in January 2017.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: How many mandals of Andhra Pradesh are covered under the APRIGP (Rural Inclusive Growth Project) ?
questions.x: The World Bank-assisted AP Rural Inclusive Growth Project covers 150 of the most backward mandals.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: What are the weights to population and area of a State applied by the 14th Finance Commission for distribution of grants ?
questions.x: The 14th Finance Commission split local body grants among states on 2011 population (90%) and area (10%). (Testbook answer not found; answer checked independently.)
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: In the second phase of the National Rurban Mission (NRuM), how many clusters have been selected from Andhra Pradesh ?
questions.x: Six AP clusters were approved in Phase II of the Rurban Mission: Alur, Nandalur, Garividi, Sompeta, Nuzendla and Chandarlapadu.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: As mentioned in the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2017-18, how many Self-help groups were organized by SERP ?
questions.x: The AP Budget 2017-18 said SERP had organised about 7 lakh self-help groups.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: As per Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) Policy 2015-2020 of the Government of Andhra Pradesh, what is the expected new investment in the MSME Sector by 2020 ?
questions.x: AP's MSME Policy 2015-20 aimed to attract Rs 15,000 crore of new MSME investment by 2020 and create about 3.5 lakh jobs. (Testbook answer not found; answer checked independently.)
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: In which of the following places are famous lacquer toys made by artisans ?
questions.x: Etikoppaka (Visakhapatnam district) on the Varaha river is known for turned-wood toys finished in lacquer colours, which carry a GI tag.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: The Arts, Crafts and Heritage villages established by the Government of Andhra Pradesh for showcasing handicrafts of artisans are called
